# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.2 Worker 2: Colonization 3.0 Core — Cold-Start Cure, Golden Loop, Chartered Companies & Late-Game Autonomy (oe_col3_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v122_col3_core.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Ensures all oe_col3 scalar counters exist before any change_variable.
oe_col3_ensure_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_convoy_count } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_convoy_count value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_boosted_colonies } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_boosted_colonies value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_autonomy_stage } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_stage value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_crackdown_heat value = 0 }
	}
}

# Upgrade 1: Official Settler Convoy & Pioneer Supply Fleet (3-year CD; cabinet-free triple cure for "+0 pending").
oe_col3_dispatch_supply_convoy = {
	save_scope_as = oe_col3_actor
	oe_col3_ensure_init = yes
	add_gold = -75
	set_variable = { name = oe_col3_convoy_cd years = 3 value = 1 }
	change_variable = { name = oe_col3_convoy_count add = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_col3_supply_convoy_mod
		years = 3
		mode = replace
	}
	# Locate most populous metropolitan source province.
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_overseas_for_owner = no
			population >= 10
		}
		order_by = population
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_col3_home_loc
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:oe_col3_home_loc }
			exists = capital
		}
		capital = { save_scope_as = oe_col3_home_loc }
	}
	# Locate smallest overseas market center / staging port needing bootstrap.
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_overseas_for_owner = yes
			OR = {
				is_market_center = yes
				is_port = yes
			}
		}
		order_by = { value = 50 subtract = population }
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_col3_hub_loc
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_col3_hub_loc }
		scope:oe_col3_hub_loc = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col3_convoy_port_supply_mod
				years = 5
				mode = replace
			}
			# Pioneer peasant/burgher seed when overseas hub is below 10,000 pops (breaks "+0 pending" market lock).
			if = {
				limit = { population < 10 }
				add_pop = {
					culture = scope:oe_col3_actor.culture
					religion = scope:oe_col3_actor.religion
					type = pop_type:peasants
					size = 0.35
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = scope:oe_col3_actor.culture
					religion = scope:oe_col3_actor.religion
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:oe_col3_home_loc
				NOT = { scope:oe_col3_hub_loc.province_definition = scope:oe_col3_home_loc.province_definition }
			}
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_col3_actor
				from = scope:oe_col3_home_loc.province_definition
				to = scope:oe_col3_hub_loc.province_definition
				amount = 0.25
				months = 36
			}
		}
	}
	# Direct homeland settler convoy streams into up to 2 active colonial charters.
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_col3_home_loc
			has_colonial_charters = yes
		}
		ordered_colonial_charter = {
			limit = {
				exists = province_definition
				NOT = { province_definition = scope:oe_col3_home_loc.province_definition }
			}
			order_by = { value = 1 }
			max = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_col3_active_charter
			add_migration = {
				owner = scope:oe_col3_actor
				from = scope:oe_col3_home_loc.province_definition
				to = scope:oe_col3_active_charter.province_definition
				amount = 0.20
				months = 36
			}
		}
	}
}

# Upgrade 2: Grant 10-year Frontier Charter Integration Boost on charter completion (connects to oe_road_ Mode 3 & oe_cul2).
# Wired by Stage via on_colonial_charter_finished -> oe_v122_col3_charter_finished_hook.
oe_col3_on_charter_finished = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations > 0
		}
		save_scope_as = oe_col3_actor
		oe_col3_ensure_init = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_col2_last_colony_loc
				var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc ?= {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = scope:oe_col3_actor
				}
			}
			var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc ?= {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_col3_boosted_colonies add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			ordered_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_overseas_for_owner = yes
					NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod }
				}
				order_by = population
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
				scope:oe_col3_actor = { change_variable = { name = oe_col3_boosted_colonies add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Upgrade 2 & 3 Quarterly Pulse (lightweight O(1) gated; wired by Stage via quarterly_country_pulse).
oe_col3_quarterly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations > 0
		}
		# 1. Refresh Frontier Integration Boost on newly built Overseas Governor Palaces not yet over 0.65 control.
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_overseas_for_owner = yes
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace
					NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod }
					local_control < 0.65
				}
			}
			ordered_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_overseas_for_owner = yes
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace
					NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod }
					local_control < 0.65
				}
				order_by = population
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col3_frontier_charter_boost_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		# 2. Chartered Company quarterly flavor dispatcher (human-only, throttled: 12-year cooldown).
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_col3_is_chartered_company_power = yes
				current_year >= 1480
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_company_ev_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_company_ev_cd years = 12 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active
					NOT = { tag = POR }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev3_seen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev3_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active
						any_neighbor_country = { has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active }
					}
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev4_seen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev4_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.4
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev1_seen } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev1_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.1
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.2
			}
		}
	}
}

# Upgrade 4: Imperial Federation & Autonomy Act Decision Effects
oe_col3_enact_imperial_federation = {
	oe_col3_ensure_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_col3_federation_enacted value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_stage value = 4 }
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_col3_imperial_federation_mod
		years = 40
		mode = replace
	}
	every_subject = {
		limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
		add_liberty_desire = -25
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.8
}

oe_col3_enact_colonial_autonomy_act = {
	oe_col3_ensure_init = yes
	add_gold = -150
	set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_act_enacted value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_colonial_tea_boycott_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_col3_colonial_tea_boycott_mod
	}
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_col3_colonial_autonomy_act_mod
		years = 30
		mode = replace
	}
	every_subject = {
		limit = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
		add_liberty_desire = -20
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.12
}

# Dev Panel Page 93 (oe_dev.93) Helper Effects (ZERO debug_log; BUILDCOST = 0)

# Command 2612: Clear convoy cooldown, ensure gold >= 100, and run oe_col3_dispatch_supply_convoy immediately.
oe_col3_dev_dispatch_convoy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_col3_convoy_cd }
		remove_variable = oe_col3_convoy_cd
	}
	if = {
		limit = { gold < 100 }
		add_gold = 100
	}
	oe_col3_dispatch_supply_convoy = yes
}

# Command 2613: Clear 3-year Official Settler Convoy cooldown.
oe_col3_dev_clear_convoy_cd = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_col3_convoy_cd }
		remove_variable = oe_col3_convoy_cd
	}
}

# Command 2614: Free-build oe_col3_colonial_recruitment_bureau in first eligible overseas port/market or capital.
oe_col3_dev_build_bureau = {
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_overseas_for_owner = yes
			OR = {
				is_port = yes
				is_market_center = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_recruitment_bureau }
		}
		order_by = population
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc } }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_coastal = yes
					is_market_center = yes
					is_overseas_for_owner = yes
				}
				NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_recruitment_bureau }
			}
			order_by = population
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc }
			exists = capital
			capital = { NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_recruitment_bureau } }
		}
		capital = { save_scope_as = oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc }
		scope:oe_col3_dev_bureau_loc = {
			construct_building = {
				building_type = building_type:oe_col3_colonial_recruitment_bureau
				cost_multiplier = 0
				cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
				instant = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Command 2615: Free-build oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace in first overseas town/city/megalopolis (promotes rural fallback).
oe_col3_dev_build_palace = {
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_overseas_for_owner = yes
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:town
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
			}
			NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace }
		}
		order_by = population
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_col3_dev_palace_loc
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_col3_dev_palace_loc } }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_overseas_for_owner = yes
				NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace }
			}
			order_by = population
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			change_location_rank = location_rank:town
			save_scope_as = oe_col3_dev_palace_loc
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_col3_dev_palace_loc }
		scope:oe_col3_dev_palace_loc = {
			construct_building = {
				building_type = building_type:oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace
				cost_multiplier = 0
				cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
				instant = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

		years = 5
		mode = replace
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.4
}
